newsitem.title: USA: Sony sees Playstation sales at 6 mln units.
newsitem.headline: Sony sees Playstation sales at 6 mln units.

text.p: Sony Corp's Sony Computer Entertainment America said on Thursday it expects sales of its Playstation video game player to reach six million units in fiscal 1998.
In a statement, the Sony unit said if sales reach that level, the total installed base of Playstation games since being launched in 1995 would rise to nine million units.
The company did not say when fiscal 1998 ends, and a spokesman was not available for comment.
Sony said fiscal 1998 Playstation sales, to date, have topped four million units.

In total, retail sales of Playstation brand hardware, software and peripheral devices are expected to exceed $3.0 billion in North America and $9.0 billion worldwide, Sony said. It expects fiscal 1998 first and third party software sales of more than 40 million units.
